name: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023
issuingAuthority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
description: An Act to provide for the processing of digital personal data in a manner that recognises both the right of individuals to protect their personal data and the need to process such personal data for lawful purposes and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

name: Digital Personal Data Protection Rules 2025
issuingAuthority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
description: The Digital Personal Data Protection Rules 2025 provide organizations a practical roadmap for data privacy. They outline strict guidelines for user consent, breach reporting, and data handling, rolling out in phases to ensure businesses can update their compliance operations.
